item.title: DANMACHI Spinoff ASTREA RECORD Light Novels Get Manga Adaptation Launching This May
item.description: Fujino Ōmori's Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Astrea Record spinoff light novels receive a manga adaptation by Karu Yoneshiro, debuting in Monthly Big Gangan's June issue in May.

item.title: CRUNCHYROLL Data Breach: Here's What User Data Was Exposed In The Hack
item.description: Following reports that Crunchyroll was hacked, new details have now confirmed exactly what user data was exposed in the breach, including emails, IP addresses, and more.

item.title: ONE PIECE Anime Adds Ayane Sakura As Gerd And Ryōta Takeuchi As Road For Elbaph Arc Premiere
item.description: One Piece anime reveals Ayane Sakura as Gerd and Ryōta Takeuchi as Road ahead of the Elbaph arc starting April 5th. This Season reduces to maximum 26 episodes per year from 2026 after a three-month hiatus.

item.title: HIDIVE Reveals Full English Dub Cast For REINCARNATED AS A DRAGON HATCHLING Anime Show
item.description: HIDIVE announces the English dub cast for Reincarnated as a Dragon Hatchling, featuring Adam Gibbs as Ilusia and more. The isekai anime about a reborn dragon hatchling premiered its dub on March 18th.

item.title: REBORN AS A SPACE MERCENARY Anime Reveals Main Cast And October TV Premiere
item.description: The anime adaptation of Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship! announces it's starting line up of voices for the main characters in the show with a new video teaser.

item.title: Universal Studios Hollywood Gives New Details On ONE PIECE Grand Pirate Show For Fan Fest Nights
item.description: Universal Studios Hollywood reveals more about its One Piece Grand Pirate Show, a pyrotechnic-filled live stunt performance featuring the Straw Hat Pirates battling Buggy and the Marines.

item.title: DEVILS' CREST Anime Announces It Will Be Arriving In 2026 With First Teaser Trailer
item.description: Devils' Crest, the new anime adaptation from Sword Art Online creator Reki Kawahara’s light novel series, reveals a 2026 premiere date, key cast for the Ashihara twins, and main staff at Production I.G.

item.title: TOMB RAIDER KING Anime Unveils Main Visual Poster And Character Trailer Ahead Of July Premiere
item.description: The anime adaptation of SAN.G's Tomb Raider King web novel reveals its main visual, character trailer, and two new Japanese cast members. The series is set to premiere in July 2026.

item.title: Denji's Run Comes To A Halt As The CHAINSAW MAN Manga Ends In June With Chapter 232
item.description: The Chainsaw Man manga is ending with Chapter 232, concluding Part 2. The 23rd and final volume arrives in Japan on June 4th, following the series’ run since 2018 and its successful anime adaptation.

item.title: Guns N' Roses Is Performing The Ending Theme For MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM HATHAWAY THE SORCERY OF NYMPH CIRCE
item.description: The anime film MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM HATHAWAY The Sorcery of Nymph Circe releases an animated music video for its Guns N' Roses ending theme "Sweet Child O' Mine.", check it out after the jump.

item.title: The POKEMON CHAMPIONS Online Battle Game Launches April 8th On Switch And Switch 2
item.description: Pokémon Champions, a free to play online battle title focused on turn-based Single and Double Battles, arrives April 8th for Nintendo Switch and Switch 2. Check out the new trailer after the jump.

item.title: Crunchyroll Reveals Full Spring 2026 English Dub Lineup Including WITCH HAT ATELIER, RE:ZERO Season 4 And More
item.description: Crunchyroll has announced its Spring 2026 English dub slate, featuring Witch Hat Atelier, Re:ZERO Season 4, Daemons of the Shadow Realm, and more than 20 additional titles. Check out the full list here.

item.title: GUNDAM HATHAWAY Sequel The Sorcery of Nymph Circe Sets North American Theatrical Premiere For May
item.description: The second Gundam Hathaway film arrives in North American cinemas on May 15th with its English dub cast led by Caleb Yen as Hathaway and Megan Shipman as Gigi. Guns N' Roses' perform the ending song.

item.title: The Live-Action GUNDAM Film Adds Michael Mando To Cast As Production Kicks Off In Australia Next Month
item.description: The live-action Gundam film has cast Michael Mando and will begin shooting in Australia next month. The project, will also star Sydney Sweeney, Noah Centineo, and Jason Clarke.

item.title: CRUNCHYROLL To Stream MARRIAGE TOXIN Anime With A Global Premiere At Sakura-Con In April
item.description: Crunchyroll will screen the global premiere of Marriage Toxin anime at Sakura-Con on April 4th with voice actor Haruki Ishiya in attendance. The series debuts a few days after on Crunchyroll simulcast.
